notes: The words in `tagged` must stay identical to the episode's `say` text (captions depend on it). Only tags in [brackets] and CAPITALS for emphasis are added. `style` is the per-line direction; `arc` says where the line sits in the energy curve.
persona: You are an energetic, charismatic science YouTuber narrating a vertical short video. Sound like a real human influencer talking to a friend: conversational, expressive, with natural breaths and a smile in the voice. Change your speed, pitch, emphasis and rhythm with what is happening: an excited hook, tension that builds as the numbers climb (a little faster and higher each time), a punchy pause right before every big reveal, quiet awe at the climax, a playful twist, and a warm, friendly call to action. Words in CAPITALS get extra emphasis. Each line starts with a direction in parentheses: follow it, but never read the directions or the bracketed tags aloud.

lines.style: excited and fast, big smile, hit DOUBLED hard, rising on the question
lines.tagged: [excited] What if a raindrop DOUBLED in size, every second?

lines.style: relaxed and conversational, a bit slower, setting the scene
lines.tagged: It started as a normal raindrop. [short pause] Two millimeters wide.

lines.style: curious, picking up speed, impressed on the second sentence
lines.tagged: Two seconds: EIGHT millimeters. [impressed] Already bigger than almost any real raindrop.

lines.style: playful, mock-surprised, tiny pause before the object
lines.tagged: Three seconds. [short pause] The size of a MARBLE.

lines.style: faster, energy rising, punch the object
quick and bright, slightly higher pitch than before
lines.tagged: Eleven. As long as a CAR.

lines.style: quick, amused, a short laugh at how silly it is
lines.tagged: Twelve. [laughs] As tall as a HOUSE.

lines.style: tension building, faster tempo, higher pitch
lines.tagged: Sixteen. Longer than a football FIELD.
Nineteen. [building tension] Taller than ANY skyscraper on the planet.

lines.style: dramatic: steady first sentence, slow down, then a punchy pause and a low, heavy reveal
lines.tagged: At twenty seconds, it's two kilometers wide. [short pause] It doesn't rain on the city. [long pause] It SWALLOWS it.
Twenty three. [awed] Taller than Mount EVEREST.

lines.style: fast and intense, highest energy so far
lines.tagged: Twenty nine. Longer than the WHOLE island of Java.

lines.style: drop to a hushed, almost whispered build, then a clear amazed reveal
lines.tagged: [whispers] And it holds more water... [short pause] than every ocean on Earth, combined.

lines.style: big and slow, savoring the moment
lines.tagged: Thirty three seconds. [short pause] It's wider than the EARTH.

lines.style: suspenseful, slowing down, a long pause before the turn
lines.tagged: Then it gets HEAVIER than the Earth. [long pause] So the raindrop doesn't fall on Earth.

lines.style: awed and softer, slow, full of wonder
lines.tagged: [awed] Earth falls INTO the raindrop, and sinks to the middle, like a pebble.

lines.style: playful and conspiratorial, like sharing a secret
lines.tagged: [playful] Here's the twist. [short pause] Every real raindrop grows around a tiny speck of dust.

lines.style: deadpan setup, long pause, then a grin on the last word
lines.tagged: This one just found its speck. [long pause] [chuckles] Us.

lines.style: warm and friendly, straight to the viewer, smiling
lines.tagged: [friendly] What should double next? Comment below!
